name: AX: Naughty Mission
source:
Years after Dr. Gero's defeat, the Red Ribbon has succeeded in creating its greatest project to destroy the Z Fighters... Android X has finally awakened! You will play as Android X in a story that mixes action, comedy, and romance with the hottest waifus in the DB world. Discover what each one has to offer and how a machine created for evil succumbs to the pleasures this story has to offer.

[From [URL=https://creatorx21.itch.io/ax-naughty-mission]itch.io[/URL]]
